content:
jess: Heads up — planning to onboard manta-8b-v1 to the model catalog and pin it as manta-8b@v1 for hosted and dedicated. Target deploy: Wed 2026-03-25 09:00 PST. Will do canary then full rollout. Need smoke volunteers and rollback readiness.

omar: what's the quantized size and supported backends? any special kernel flags?

liam: quantized ~9.2GB (int8), tested on A10G and H100 kernels. No special flags. perf looks stable on perf harness.

sara: I'm out at 9am PST but can do pre-checks at 7:30. PR to change model pin is at https://git.redwood/ml/catalog/pulls/148 — quick review plz.

maya: I can run the canary at 09:00 and watch traces. I'll abort if tail latency > 350ms for >3 consecutive minutes. :eyes: 

noah: I can prepare rollback job. Config snippet to revert pin:
```
# curl to model-catalog service
PATCH /catalog/models/manta-8b/pin
{ "pin": "manta-8b@v0.9" }
```

jess: @sara @omar assign smoke checks:
- @maya: canary traffic (5%)
- @liam: inference correctness smoke tests (eval prompts)
- @omar: kernel/infra watch

maya: noted. what are the smoke test commands? share short list.

liam: quick smoke script:
```
./bin/run_smoke.sh --model manta-8b@v1 --prompts smoke_prompts.txt --checks=loglik,resp_len,artifact
```

sara: reviewed PR, left 1 comment about docs. pinging @eng-ml for final +1.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by jess for manta-8b-v1 at 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z (canary 5% -> 100% 30m)

omar: @jess do we pin dedicated instances as well or only hosted?

jess: both — dedicated will get a config rollout (no traffic shift) but pinned version set so customers on dedicated see consistent behavior.

noah: rollback job created: job/rollback-manta-8b-1781234567. Will be ready to trigger.

maya: canary started — sending 5% traffic now. watching traces.

maya: smoke: correctness OK (sample 200 prompts), no OOMs. latency median 180ms, p95 320ms. continuing watch. :thumbsup:

liam: running ablation tests, no regression vs v0.9 on top-1 accuracy for our eval set.

sara: docs updated and migrated, PR merged.

deploy-bot: Canary complete — 5%->100% scheduled at +30m

jess: rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. model-catalog pin updated to manta-8b@v1. :rocket:

maya: post-rollout checks: traces look clean, no error spikes.

omar: infra metrics green. marking deploy as ✅

jess: thanks all. leaving rollback job in place for 24h, then will cleanup. If anything odd, ping #eng-oncall and @noah to run rollback.

liam: quick note — will open a follow-up to add perf profile to model entry.

sara: thanks team!
